projects.name: TableTalk_CodeGen
projects.title: TableTalk CodeGen
projects.summary: CodeLlama-7B-Instruct fine-tuned with QLoRA to answer natural-language questions about tables. Instead of answering directly, the model writes a single line of pandas code, which is then run against the table to produce the answer.
projects.highlight: 75.94 on DataBench, rank 13 on the SemEval-2025 Task 8 leaderboard

projects.name: Parkinson_Disease_Detection
projects.title: Parkinson's Disease Detection from MRI
projects.summary: Registers 3D T1-weighted brain MRI to the PD25 atlas, extracts radiomic features from subcortical structures, and separates Parkinson's patients from healthy controls with SVM feature selection and a Random Forest. Served through a small Flask app.
projects.highlight: 0.96 accuracy and 0.98 ROC AUC on 148 held-out scans

projects.name: Time-Series-Based-Crop-Type-Mapping
projects.title: Crop Type Mapping from Sentinel-2
projects.summary: Pixel-wise crop-type mapping of Ontario farmland from a six-month Sentinel-2 time series, using a U-Net that shares 2D convolutions across months and pools over time.
projects.highlight: Six-month Sentinel-2 series turned into a full 2021 crop map (GeoTIFF + Earth Engine)

projects.name: Underwater-Image-Enhancement
projects.title: Underwater Image Enhancement
projects.summary: A classical, non-learning image-processing pipeline for enhancing underwater photographs. The project reproduces the DIRS-CLAHS method (Ghani & Isa, 2015) as a baseline and extends it with Colour Attenuation Compensation, adaptive CLAHE and Multi-Scale…
projects.highlight: DIRS-CLAHS reproduced and extended, scored on UIEB with PSNR, SSIM, UIQM and UCIQE

projects.name: Medicine_Rec_System
projects.title: Drug Recommendation with Biomedical BERT
projects.summary: A retrieval-based medicine recommendation system. Drug and disease descriptions are embedded with PubMedBERT and ClinicalBERT, and a disease or symptom query is matched to the closest medications with Locality-Sensitive Hashing (LSH), SimHash and FAISS.
projects.highlight: LSH, SimHash and FAISS compared on speed and match quality

projects.name: Multi-Purpose-MLP-Classification-Regression
projects.title: Multi-Task MLP: Age, Gender and Ethnicity
projects.summary: A single PyTorch multilayer perceptron that predicts gender (binary classification), ethnicity (5-class classification) and age (regression) from 48 × 48 grayscale face images at the same time.
projects.highlight: One network, three heads; about 75% gender accuracy on the test set
